module_title: NPST, National Mentoring Mission (NMM) & Merit-Based Tenure
introduction: Tailored for UGC NET and advanced educational leadership exams, this level explores the systemic overhaul of teacher accountability and career progression. It covers the National Professional Standards for Teachers (NPST), the mentoring mission, and merit-based tenure tracks.

core_concepts.title: National Professional Standards for Teachers (NPST)
core_concepts.description:
Mandated by NEP 2020 and developed by NCTE, NPST is a public statement of what constitutes 'quality teaching'. It defines the competencies required at different stages of a teacher's career. 
The 4 Career Stages under NPST:
1. Beginner Teacher (Prarambhik)
2. Proficient Teacher (Praveen)
3. Expert Teacher (Kushal)
4. Lead Teacher (Pramukh)
*Each stage has specific expectations across domains like Professional Knowledge, Practice, and Values.*

core_concepts.title: Merit-Based Tenure Track and Career Progression
core_concepts.description:
NEP 2020 abolishes the traditional 'promotion purely by seniority' system. 
- Career progression (moving from Proficient to Expert) and salary increases will be based on a robust, multi-source assessment of performance. 
- Evaluation factors: Peer reviews, student reviews, innovations in pedagogy, and the successful completion of the mandated **50 hours of CPD**.

core_concepts.title: National Mission for Mentoring (NMM / CMMP)
core_concepts.description:
To support CPD, NEP 2020 introduces the Comprehensive National Mission for Mentoring. 
- A large pool of outstanding senior/retired faculty (particularly those with prestigious awards) will be recognized as 'National Mentors'. 
- They will provide short-term and long-term mentoring and professional support to university/school teachers, ensuring pedagogical wisdom is passed down rather than lost upon retirement.

core_concepts.title: Professional Ethics and Accountability
core_concepts.description: Advanced CPD isn't just about teaching methods; it is about ethics. NCF-TE (National Curriculum Framework for Teacher Education) mandates rigorous training in professional ethics—maintaining student confidentiality, maintaining strict neutrality on controversial social issues, and upholding the constitutional values of equity and secularism in the classroom.

important_entities.name: NCTE (National Council for Teacher Education)
important_entities.key_fact: The regulatory body responsible for restructuring Teacher Education.
important_entities.significance: Under the new framework, NCTE is being restructured as a Professional Standard Setting Body (PSSB) under the General Education Council (GEC). It is the body tasked with formulating the NPST and regulating B.Ed. standards.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Examiners will state: 'Under NEP 2020, teachers will be promoted to Headmaster based strictly on their years of service.' This is **FALSE**. NEP 2020 strictly implements a **Merit-Based Tenure Track**, where continuous professional development (CPD) and demonstrated excellence dictate promotions, completely removing the 'automatic seniority' assumption.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: B P E L (Beginner, Proficient, Expert, Lead)
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Remember the career ladder acronym: BPEL. To reach the 'Lead' level, you must pass through Proficient and Expert by gathering CPD hours.

exam_strategy_tips: If an advanced UGC NET question asks 'What is the official framework that sets the performance benchmarks and career stages for teachers in India?', the answer is **NPST (National Professional Standards for Teachers)**.
